"""
Generate fig1_pipeline: Cross-lingual knowledge conflict probing pipeline overview.
Three blocks: Data Construction → Probing Framework → Confound Exclusion.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import os

# --- Global style ---
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

# Colors
BG_BLUE   = '#E8F4FD'
BG_ORANGE = '#FFF3E0'
BG_GREEN  = '#E8F5E9'
C_EN      = '#0072B2'
C_ZH      = '#E69F00'
C_CHECK   = '#009E73'
C_ARROW   = '#555555'
C_BLOCK_BORDER = '#AAAAAA'
C_STEP_BG = '#FFFFFF'
C_STEP_BORDER = '#CCCCCC'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.8))
ax.set_xlim(0, 11)
ax.set_ylim(0, 3.8)
ax.axis('off')

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Helper functions
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def draw_block_bg(ax, x, y, w, h, color, title, section_label):
    """Draw a rounded-rect block background with title and section label."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                         facecolor=color, edgecolor=C_BLOCK_BORDER,
                         linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h - 0.18, title,
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', zorder=5)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + 0.12, section_label,
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7, color='#666666',
            fontstyle='italic', zorder=5)

def draw_step_box(ax, cx, cy, text, w=2.4, h=0.32, fontsize=8,
                  fc=C_STEP_BG, ec=C_STEP_BORDER, textcolor='black',
                  fontweight='normal', zorder=3):
    """Draw a single step box centered at (cx, cy)."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                         facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec,
                         linewidth=0.8, zorder=zorder)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fontsize, color=textcolor, fontweight=fontweight,
            zorder=zorder+1)
    return cy

def draw_down_arrow(ax, cx, y_from, y_to, color=C_ARROW):
    """Small downward arrow between steps."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(cx, y_to + 0.16), xytext=(cx, y_from - 0.16),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=1.2),
                zorder=4)

def draw_big_arrow(ax, x_from, x_to, y_mid, color=C_ARROW):
    """Large horizontal arrow between blocks."""
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch((x_from, y_mid), (x_to, y_mid),
                            arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=18,
                            color=color, linewidth=2.2, zorder=6)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Block 1 — Data Construction (left)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
b1_x, b1_y, b1_w, b1_h = 0.15, 0.3, 3.05, 3.25
draw_block_bg(ax, b1_x, b1_y, b1_w, b1_h, BG_BLUE,
              'Data Construction', '§3.2 Data')

b1_cx = b1_x + b1_w / 2
steps_b1 = [
    ('ConflictQA Dataset', 2.95),
    ('Parametric Knowledge\nVerification (per-model)', 2.45),
    ('Translation (EN→ZH,\nvia Qwen3-8B)', 1.92),
    ('COMET Back-translation\nValidation', 1.39),
]

for text, cy in steps_b1:
    draw_step_box(ax, b1_cx, cy, text, w=2.55, h=0.36, fontsize=7.5)

# Arrows between steps
for i in range(len(steps_b1) - 1):
    draw_down_arrow(ax, b1_cx, steps_b1[i][1], steps_b1[i+1][1])

# Final output box — EN/ZH colored
final_cy = 0.82
final_w, final_h = 2.55, 0.36
box_final = FancyBboxPatch((b1_cx - final_w/2, final_cy - final_h/2),
                           final_w, final_h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                           facecolor=C_STEP_BG, edgecolor='#888888',
                           linewidth=1.0, zorder=3)
ax.add_patch(box_final)
# Two-color text: EN / ZH
ax.text(b1_cx - 0.22, final_cy, 'EN', ha='right', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color=C_EN, fontweight='bold', zorder=4)
ax.text(b1_cx, final_cy, '/', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color='#333333', zorder=4)
ax.text(b1_cx + 0.22, final_cy, 'ZH', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color=C_ZH, fontweight='bold', zorder=4)
ax.text(b1_cx, final_cy - 0.14, 'Parallel Conflict Data', ha='center', va='top',
        fontsize=6.5, color='#555555', zorder=4)

draw_down_arrow(ax, b1_cx, steps_b1[-1][1], final_cy)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Block 2 — Probing Framework (center)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
b2_x, b2_y, b2_w, b2_h = 3.72, 0.3, 3.55, 3.25
draw_block_bg(ax, b2_x, b2_y, b2_w, b2_h, BG_ORANGE,
              'Probing Framework', '§3.4–3.5 Probing')

b2_cx = b2_x + b2_w / 2

# Step 1: Residual Stream Extraction
draw_step_box(ax, b2_cx, 2.95, 'Residual Stream Extraction\n(last-token, all L layers)',
              w=3.0, h=0.38, fontsize=7.5)

# Step 2: Linear Probe Training
draw_step_box(ax, b2_cx, 2.38, 'Linear Probe Training\n(per-layer logistic regression)',
              w=3.0, h=0.38, fontsize=7.5)

draw_down_arrow(ax, b2_cx, 2.95, 2.38)

# Step 3: 4-Direction Transfer Protocol — mini matrix
mat_cy = 1.65
mat_cx = b2_cx
mat_w, mat_h = 2.3, 0.85
# Background for mini matrix
mat_bg = FancyBboxPatch((mat_cx - mat_w/2, mat_cy - mat_h/2),
                        mat_w, mat_h,
                        boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                        facecolor='#FFFAF0', edgecolor='#CCAA77',
                        linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
ax.add_patch(mat_bg)

# Title above matrix
ax.text(mat_cx, mat_cy + mat_h/2 + 0.03, '4-Direction Transfer Protocol',
        ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

draw_down_arrow(ax, b2_cx, 2.38, mat_cy + mat_h/2 + 0.05)

# Draw 2x2 grid
# Header row
hdr_y = mat_cy + 0.22
ax.text(mat_cx + 0.05, hdr_y, 'Train EN', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=6.5, color=C_EN, fontweight='bold', zorder=5)
ax.text(mat_cx + 0.75, hdr_y, 'Train ZH', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=6.5, color=C_ZH, fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Row labels + cells
row1_y = mat_cy + 0.02
row2_y = mat_cy - 0.20
lbl_x = mat_cx - 0.72

ax.text(lbl_x, row1_y, 'Test EN', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=6.5, color=C_EN, fontweight='bold', zorder=5)
ax.text(lbl_x, row2_y, 'Test ZH', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=6.5, color=C_ZH, fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Cell values
cells = [
    (mat_cx + 0.05, row1_y, 'EN→EN', '#333333'),
    (mat_cx + 0.75, row1_y, 'ZH→EN', '#333333'),
    (mat_cx + 0.05, row2_y, 'EN→ZH', '#333333'),
    (mat_cx + 0.75, row2_y, 'ZH→ZH', '#333333'),
]
for cx, cy, txt, col in cells:
    # Small cell background
    cell_box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - 0.28, cy - 0.10), 0.56, 0.20,
                              boxstyle="round,pad=0.02",
                              facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDDDDD',
                              linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(cell_box)
    ax.text(cx, cy, txt, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=6, color=col, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=5)

# Divider lines in matrix
ax.plot([mat_cx - 0.35, mat_cx + 1.10], [hdr_y - 0.10, hdr_y - 0.10],
        color='#CCAA77', linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
ax.plot([mat_cx - 0.35, mat_cx - 0.35], [hdr_y - 0.10, row2_y - 0.12],
        color='#CCAA77', linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)

# Step 4: Bootstrap CI
draw_step_box(ax, b2_cx, 0.90, 'Bootstrap CI (n = 2000)',
              w=2.4, h=0.32, fontsize=7.5)

draw_down_arrow(ax, b2_cx, mat_cy - mat_h/2, 0.90)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Block 3 — Confound Exclusion (right)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
b3_x, b3_y, b3_w, b3_h = 7.82, 0.3, 2.95, 3.25
draw_block_bg(ax, b3_x, b3_y, b3_w, b3_h, BG_GREEN,
              'Confound Exclusion', '§3.6 Controls')

b3_cx = b3_x + b3_w / 2
checks = [
    'COMET Tercile Ablation',
    'Token Overlap Analysis',
    'XNLI Non-conflict Baseline',
]

check_ys = [2.55, 1.90, 1.25]
for text, cy in zip(checks, check_ys):
    cw, ch = 2.45, 0.40
    box = FancyBboxPatch((b3_cx - cw/2, cy - ch/2), cw, ch,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                         facecolor=C_STEP_BG, edgecolor='#88BB88',
                         linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    # Green checkmark
    ax.text(b3_cx - cw/2 + 0.18, cy, '✓', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, color=C_CHECK, fontweight='bold', zorder=4)
    # Label
    ax.text(b3_cx + 0.08, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=7.5, color='#333333', zorder=4)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Big arrows between blocks
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
arrow_y = 1.90
draw_big_arrow(ax, b1_x + b1_w + 0.06, b2_x - 0.06, arrow_y)
draw_big_arrow(ax, b2_x + b2_w + 0.06, b3_x - 0.06, arrow_y)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Save
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-prod42/projects/clkc_mech_interp/figures/paper'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

fig.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, 'fig1_pipeline.pdf'), format='pdf')
fig.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, 'fig1_pipeline.png'), format='png')
plt.close(fig)
print('Done — saved fig1_pipeline.pdf and fig1_pipeline.png')
